blocks.p: Angel works out the route back to the station on the map. The map is the *Maps* tab of the *World* window, shown in Figure 13-1 on the facing page.
To put a mark on the map, pick it up from the bar along the top of the map, then click the map where the mark goes. *Aa* writes a note on the map. Angel's note marks the station.
At the foot of the map, *Survey*, *Color* and *Paper* choose the style of the map. The map key shows what the colors on the *Survey* map mean. It lists eight kinds of place:
To close the map key, click the close box at its top left.

marks.text: Pick a mark up, then click the map to put it down. Aa writes a note.

sticky.text: Marks and notes on the map.

blocks.p: A flyer you have read pins its place on the map: a paper with a red thumbtack. A blue tick on the paper means that you have been there. Point at a pin to see its card: the place, the flyer's headline, *Been there* and *Click to read*. Click the pin to read the flyer.
Figure 13-1 shows West Point on the *Survey* map, with the map key open and the pointer on the pin for the flyer. Angel's note sits beside the pin: the station, at 205 Second Street.
